title: SolutionRecord
description: The answer, its audit trail, and which technique produced it. The training signal is the technique field. Single writer: Librarian (Close). Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

ledger_version.description: The ledger version this record was written against. A CandidateRecord citing a version other than the frozen one is rejected by the Scribe.

references.description: Ids of the records this one is derived from or responds to. Never edit those records; reference them.

answer.description: The answer as the requester will read it.

unverified_load_bearing.description: PremiseRecords the answer depends on that remain unverified. Non-negotiable in every mode: this list is always present, even when empty.

audit_trail.description: Every record the answer rests on, in order.

problem_type.description: Copied from the FrameRecord, for the library index.
